name: 1 - Stand Down
description: Nice simple route. Run along Higher Lane, turn left onto Ringley Road, turn right along Stand Lane, then turn right on Radcliffe New Road run along until the Goats Gate pub then turn right onto Dales Lane and keep running until you get back to the start.

name: 2 - Threading the Needle Reloaded
description: So cross over the road run around curry house. Left at Egerton, down at Pinfold, up at hamilton down at Church. Go around Goat's gate miss out Church, go down Hamilton, up Pinfold, down Egerton then back to the end.

name: 3 - Prestwich run around
description: From Aldi, down to the subway and over, through that little cut through which brings us out on to Bury Old Road, 1st right on to Nursey Rd, at the bottom turn left along Heys Rd, past Heys Sch, turn left, up the tiny little hill, cross over the road, straight on to where the shops are, left turn on to Mount Rd, over Sandgate, left on to Thatch Leech Lane, at the top turn right back to Aldi.

name: 4 - Whitefield Runaround (Fusiliers)
description: So run up along Higher Lane, crossing when you can find a safe spot before turnning right and coming down Church Ln. Turn left and run towards Bury on the New Road crossing again whenever there is a safe spot. Turn right down Rufford Drive follow this down to the chip shop turn right again along Parr Lane past the gym, turn left and then right onto Albert Road; then follow this along to run across the Fusiliers Meadow if this is closed just go past it and follow the road around. Turn right back onto Thatch Leach Lane, the right onto the Old Road back to the start.

name: 5 - Whitefield OaB (Ringley)
description: Ok most OaB around Whitefield require going up and down big hills or busy roads, not this one. So run out of McD to the left follow Higher Lane until you turn left onto Ringley Rd changing to the other side of the road asap. Keep going for 20 minutes and then turn around.

name: 6 - Bury OaB
description: Run along Bury New Road towards Bury for 20 mins, turn around and run back.

name: 7 - Manchester OaB
description: Run along Bury New Road towards Macnchester for 20 mins, turn around and run back.

name: 8 - Prestwich Loop from Bury Old to New
gpx: ./gpx/Prestwich Loop from Bury Old to New.gpx
description: Nice simple route starting on Bury Old Road run down toward Prestwich keep going until you reach Heaton Park Tram station turn right here. Follow this lane straight on and then at the junction keep going straight again (St Marys Rd). When you reach Bury New Road turn right and follow that all the way back to McD starting point.

name: 9 - Mairead's Circle
description: Run down Higher Lane, down Dales Lane. Right at the Goats Gate along RnR then turn left onto Bury New Road for a short while before turning right onto Rufford Lane, follow that down until you turn right on Parr Lane, then run until you reach the gym turning right just before and run up to Morrisons, turn left onto Bury New Road and return to start.

name: 10 - Dale's Hammer
description: Run up Higher Lane, Left onto Park Lane. Right at Parkstone Ave and then onto Hillingdon / Sunningdale / Old Hall. Right onto Ringley and left down Dales. Right at Goats Gate up RNR the Right at BNR back to the start.

name: 11 - Prestwich via Heaton Edge
description: So from McD cross over to the left side of Bury Old Road then begin the run turning left on Thatch Leach Lane run until the Frigate pub and turn right own Sandgate Road crossing over the the motorway. Keep running until you reach then take a quick shimmy to the left before turning right onto the road next to the reservoir (St Margarets Road) just follow that around until you reach Bury Old Road again.  Turn left for a little run until you take a right along Heys Road (Tattoo parlour) keep following that all the way down into Prestwich town centre. Cross under the tram and run down fairfax then take a right at M&S keep running to run back under the motorway take the left subway back up and return to McD start point.

name: 12 - Whitefield Hills
description: So run along higher lane before turning left through a ginnel to Ringley Chase, run around posh fountain, then back to run right onto Ringley Drive then left onto Ringley Road, then right again down Stand Lane. Turn Right onto Hollinhurst Road to cut the corner. then right on Radcliffe New Road for a little, teeny, tiny uphill bit. Turn right again at the goats gate to run along Dales Lane, Higher Lane to return.
